rows.text: Some radical members of the Universal Culinary Society believe that eating and hunger are the Primum Mobile of the Path of Voracity, but consuming food prepared by others is heresy. Insisting on personally completing the entire process from slaughter to cooking and tenderizing meat through life-or-death combat, they forged these "thermal weapons," which was meant for heating. The outcome, however, often ends up with ingredients being blasted into charcoal.
